headline: Meet Clara Schoonover, L.M.T.
intro: Skilled, caring, and dedicated to helping every client feel their best — inside and out.
paragraphs: Clara Schoonover is a licensed massage therapist and cosmetologist who’s been helping people in Chickasha feel more comfortable in their bodies for years.
Her work blends therapeutic massage, soft tissue mobilization, orthopedic techniques, reflexology, and other evidence-informed approaches to help clients feel relief, support, and lasting comfort.
Every session is shaped around your goals—whether you need stress relief, pain management, better mobility, or simply a chance to reset.
whyChooseItems: Personalized treatment plans built around your body and goals
Serving Chickasha with professional, respectful care
specialtiesIntro: Trained approaches Clara draws on to tailor every session.
